title: Nuclear astrophysics: reaction atlas, R-matrix evaluations and reaction rates
description:
Source code and content of Jakub Skowronski's research website: a reaction atlas of the nuclear reactions that power stars, with references and plain-language explanations in English and Italian; interactive R-matrix evaluations run with AZURE2, natively or in the browser; a reaction-rate explorer built on JINA REACLIB and pynucastro; a nuclear data explorer of EXFOR and ENSDF; a browser demo of WebDAQ, the data acquisition developed for LUNA; and notes on R-matrix theory.

The site was built with AI assistance (Claude, by Anthropic) under the author's direction and scientific responsibility; see the site's About page.
